name: Get Leads by Filter Type
summary: Finds leads whose field matches one of your values — the workhorse for pulling data: by email, by ID, by name, by company, by list, or by any custom field.
whenToUse: The most common data pull: 'give me the lead(s) with this email', 'all leads in this static list', 'leads with this lead score'. If more than 1,000 leads match, Marketo refuses — narrow the filter or use a Bulk Extract.

query.name: filterType
query.label: Filter on (field)
query.hint: The lead field to match. Common: email, id, firstName, lastName, company, listId, leadIds, phone, website, or any custom field. Run 'Describe Leads2' for the full allowed list.

query.name: filterValues
query.label: Matching value(s)
query.hint: Up to 300 comma-separated values. A lead is returned if its 'Filter on' field equals any of these.

query.name: fields
query.label: Fields to return
query.hint: Pick which fields to include. If you pick none, Marketo returns only the basics: id, email, first name, last name, and created/updated dates.

query.name: batchSize
query.label: Batch size (max per page)
query.hint: Optional. Maximum records per response (max 300). Leave blank for the default.

response.description: Up to 300 lead records (or fewer). If 'moreResult' is true, a 'nextPageToken' is included for the next page.

notes: More than 1,000 matching leads → error 1003 'Too many results' — narrow the filter or use a Bulk Extract.
Very long value lists can hit the 8 KB URL limit (error 414) — split into smaller batches.
